svg.aria-label: Map of the Black Sea. A grey lane and an amber dashed line run from Novorossiysk on Russia's coast south-west to the Bosporus; amber means the route operates under attack. Strike markers sit at Tuapse, whose refinery and terminal were suspended after strikes between April and May 2026, and just off Sochi, where the tanker Aframax Rio caught fire on 6 October 2026; the cause has not been officially confirmed.
svg.text: The Black Sea: Russia's southern oil coast
the second front of the oil war — Ukrainian drones against Russian ports, refineries and tankers
